notes: GB205: 12GB VRAM, MOT chip NVENC gen 9, MOT chip NVDEC.
Khac 5080/5070 Ti (GB203, 16GB, HAI NVENC) — moi con so o day deu tinh cho mot chip encode.
Moi khoa duoi day deu la khoa THAT doc trong ma nguon; xem field 'why'.
_comment_removeKeys: Khoa chet: con lai trong settings.json se lam sai hanh vi hoac gay nham lan.
_comment_autoDetect: Installer do phan cung that va ghi de vao settings truoc khi ap overlay.
_comment_hardware: NHOM 1 — phan cung. Doc boi get_resolved_hardware_config() (src-tauri/src/commands.rs:4210).

why.hardwareProfile.vramGB: QUAN TRONG NHAT. commands.rs:4219 lay min(profile_vram, vram_do_duoc). Gia tri 6 trong settings.json cu se ep min(6,12)=6 -> nhanh 'Low': render_workers 2, chunk_workers 2, gpu_tier=Low. Tier Low lam ffmpeg.rs:2099 chon h264_nvenc thay vi hevc_nvenc, va h264 @6M cho 720x1280@30 bi doi bitrate -> QP pumping, dung trieu chung 'giat lag' da ghi o ffmpeg.rs:2090. De 12 -> nhanh '>=12 High': preset p3, tier High, hevc_nvenc.
why.hardwareProfile.ramGB: commands.rs:4236 cap theo RAM that: <16GB ep render_workers ve 1, <24GB ve 2, <32GB ve 3. Khai bao thap hon RAM that la tu bop hieu nang.
why.maxConcurrentRenders: commands.rs:4341 — user override thang moi tinh toan phia tren. 2 la tran hop ly cho MOT chip NVENC: worker thu 2 chi lap day phan filter/audio/mux trong khi worker 1 dang encode. 3 tro len chi chia nho cung mot encoder, chua ke ~1.5GB VRAM/worker.
why.maxConcurrentDownloads: 1. commands.rs:4348 ghi ro: N download song song thi moi cai chay ~1/N toc do va MOI video deu xong muon hon la lam tuan tu. Khach muon 'phat hien truoc = xong truoc'.
why.parallelChunkRender: false. ffmpeg.rs:1319 should_parallel_chunk() doi tier High + khoa nay. Chunk song song CHI co lai tren card 2+ NVENC (system.rs gpu_has_multi_nvenc). RTX 5070 co mot chip: bat len se lam render CHAM DI (do 0.86x tren may mot NVENC).
why.pollIntervalMs: 2000 — nhip mong muon theo spec Pass 6 (san 1000). Day chi la SAN: api_detector tu gian nhip theo ngan sach quota con lai, nen de 2000 khong lam cháy quota.
why.autoDownloadQuality: Nang 360 -> 720. Ban 360p up-scale len khung 1080x1920 nhin ro vo. Doi lai moi video tai nang gap ~3 lan — chap nhan duoc tren duong truyen Nhat. Muon uu tien toc do e2e thi doi lai '360' o dung dong nay.
why.autoRenderResolution: Nang 720p -> 1080p. ffmpeg.rs:2107 cho 1080p tran maxrate 12M (720p chi 6M). RTX 5070 dư suc; day la ly do chinh mua may nay.
why.autoRender: De false theo dung khuyen nghi trong docs/CUSTOMER_SETUP_GUIDE.md — bat sau khi khach da xem thu vai video ra dung y. Bat trong Cai dat, khong can cai lai.
why.bypassVpn: false. Khi true, youtube.rs goi get_physical_ip() -> spawn PowerShell (~1-1.5s/lan, co cache 5 phut) de bind --source-address. May Nhat di thang khong qua VPN nen khong can, va tranh luon chi phi do.
why.onboardingComplete: false — de khach di het wizard 5 buoc va tu dang nhap Chrome tren MAY CUA HO (cookie Chrome ma hoa bang DPAPI theo tai khoan Windows, khong the bung tu may khac sang).

japanNotes.khungGioKenh: Khung gio quet cua tung kenh (window_start/window_end) tinh theo GIO VIET NAM UTC+7 co dinh — api_detector.rs:76 vn_minute_of_day(), khong doc dong ho may. Tren may Nhat (JST, UTC+9) khung '18:00-23:00' trong app = 20:00-01:00 gio Nhat. Muon dung theo gio Nhat thi tru 2 tieng khi nhap.
japanNotes.resetQuota: So quota reset theo 0h gio Pacific, tinh bang UTC-8 co dinh (api_detector.rs:59). Quy ra gio Nhat: 17:00 JST hang ngay.
japanNotes.ngayNghiepVu: Bo dem 'kenh nay da bat du n video hom nay' reset theo ngay UTC+7 (api_detector.rs:65) = 02:00 JST.
japanNotes.dongHoMay: Ca ba moc tren deu tinh tu epoch UTC nen KHONG phu thuoc timezone Windows. Dat timezone may la Tokyo chi de log de doc.
japanNotes.cookieChrome: cookies_dpapi.rs dung CryptUnprotectData — cookie Chrome ma hoa rang buoc tai khoan Windows. Thu muc chrome-profiles bung tu may operator sang may khach se KHONG giai ma duoc. Khach bat buoc phai dang nhap YouTube tren chinh may cua ho o buoc 1 cua wizard.
